row:
As physical therapy providers in Arizona for over 20 years, our reputation hasn't been built on luck. Instead, it's been built on our daily commitment to the needs of our patients and clients. Our growth from 1 clinic to 20+ speaks to the loyalty of our referral sources, our patients, our clients, and the positive outcomes they've experienced through Foothills.

We're dedicated to providing hands-on physical therapy with integrity and accountability to ensure the best possible patient results. Whether you've suffered a sports injury, were injured at work, or were hurt in an auto accident, our physical therapists will help you get your move back. 

We're grateful for the support we've earned over the years and look forward to serving the physical therapy needs of the community for years to come.
